title: Subsidy grant body
description: A capped allowance of subsidy units for one agent (residency.md 5 to 7, register row DK85; spec-delta S300). Signed by the City-budget DID. Not a credit grant: it never creates, adds or repays a credit. Within its budget's period and the class caps; one active grant per agent and class; a newcomer grant once per agent; a resident grant needs tier 1 and 3 qualifying jobs; refused when the budget is spent. Chain: none (prev is null).
